full_judgment: 18. In order to prove these allegations, the plaintiff examined PW 1 who is the constituted attorney of the plaintiff who admittedly has no personal knowledge about the physical condition of the articles at the time of loading of the cargo in the container and the carrying of the same to the port of Chittagong and therefore, he deposed before this Court on the basis of the record as available to him supplied by the plaintiff. The PW 1 in his examination-in-chief stated that the plaintiff reside in the USA and in order to bring back his household articles, which are 383 pieces in number, were shipped through the shipping agent defendant No.4. The plaintiff's cargo were sealed in the container No. HJCU 888110-7 and loaded in the vessel 'MV Vladivostok Senator' upon issued Bill of Lading No. A1657 dated 14-11-1997. He stated that the pre-inspection was held and the PSI Agent certified the quantity and condition of the cargo which was loaded on board of the defendant's vessel, which sailed from Baltimore USA on 14-11-1997 and the cargo was transshipped at the port of Singapore to be carried by the feeder vessel `MV Padma' to the port of Chittagong. The defendant No. 3 issued notice of readiness on 7-1-1998 and the said vessel 'MV Padma' took berth on 10-1-1998. The C&F Agent informed the defendant No.3 on 26-1-1998 to employ a representative at the time of opening and delivery of the container. The plaintiff appointed surveyor Messrs Agrani Inspection Co. who surveyed the container at the time of delivery, which found after opening the seal of the container, the damaged goods inside due to contact with saline water and, as such, on cargo was delivered by the defendant to the plaintiff. Therefore, the plaintiff has suffered a loss on account of loss of household articles worth. Taka 15,58,000,00 and on the freight at Taka 1,59,800,00, on the purchase of the furniture from the local market at Taka 3,00,00,000, on the survey of the goods at Taka 1,000,00 and as the interest and cost at Taka 3,00,525,00 which he claimed from the defendants by way of decree of this Court.
